svg.title: Acronox — Alexis Baret
svg.desc: GitHub profile of Alexis Baret, software engineering student at IMT Atlantique in Brest
svg.text: I build things to understand them.
SCHOOL LABS, SIDE PROJECTS, AND WHAT I LEARN FROM BOTH

g.text: I like knowing what happens under the hood:
how nodes agree, how interfaces feel, how agents decide.
Right now: failure detection in Elixir, a generative banking UI, and too many lab reports.
School projects, side experiments, and a few things I broke on purpose.
Five sessions a week, no skipping.
After the gym, before the next lab.
